content: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. In the next section, we provide a discussion of existing work. Section SECREF3 then presents our model for embedding geographic locations from Flickr tags and structured data. Next, in Section SECREF4 we provide a detailed discussion about the experimental results. Finally, Section SECREF5 summarizes our conclusions.
